purpose: Prevent exact-SKU product identity drift in generated social content.
hard_rules: For exact SKU/product pages, the product object itself must NOT be generatively redrawn, hallucinated, recolored, re-embossed, re-logoed, or restyled.
When a first-party brand image exists, R09 must use the verified official product pixels as a locked visual layer/reference anchor rather than synthesizing a lookalike product.

Allowed non-destructive operations on official product asset: crop, scale, background removal/masking, placement, and adding external shadow/background around the product. Do not alter product color layout, logo, pan geometry, pouch pattern, packaging hardware, embossing, or SKU-specific accessories.
If the official source cannot be fetched/read clearly enough to preserve identity, result must be BLOCKED_INPUT_MISSING or BLOCKED_PRODUCT_UNCERTAIN. Never substitute a generated lookalike.
Every product-bearing page must record source_role, source_url/ref_id, SKU lock id, and the exact official source used.
R10 must compare actual final pixels against the official first-party source, not only against text descriptions.
Official flagship store assets on Tmall/JD may be used only after verifying that the seller is the brand's official flagship and the listing matches the same SKU/season.
